injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries.note: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.note: Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.note: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.note: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Anthony Black
injuries.note: Black (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Minnesota but participated in shootaround and has experienced no setbacks in his recovery, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.note: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Santi Aldama
injuries.note: Aldama (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Nic Claxton
injuries.note: Claxton (hamstring) will be re-evaluated in two weeks, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.note: Harris (calf) is out for Friday's game against the Rockets.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.note: Raynaud (knee) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, and potentially longer, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.note: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.note: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jake LaRavia
injuries.note: LaRavia (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers, Mark Medina of TheSportingTribune.com reports.

injuries.name: Coby White
injuries.note: White (calf) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.note: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Max Strus
injuries.note: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.note: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.note: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.note: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Oso Ighodaro
injuries.note: Ighodaro has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Warriors due to an oblique strain, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.note: Sheppard (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Mavericks and there's no timetable for his return, according to head coach Rick Carlisle per Alex Golden of SI.com.

injuries.name: Dylan Cardwell
injuries.note: Cardwell (calf) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, with a longer absence possible, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.note: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.note: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries.name: Grant Williams
injuries.note: Williams (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

injuries.name: Devin Carter
injuries.note: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy
injuries.note: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.note: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against Dallas.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.note: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Nikola Topic
injuries.note: Topic (back) won't play in Thursday's game against the Nuggets.

injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.note: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Julian Strawther
injuries.note: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

injuries.name: Caleb Martin
injuries.note: Martin (thumb) has been ruled out for Fridays' game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.note: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.note: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Trey Alexander
injuries.note: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

injuries.name: Charles Bassey
injuries.note: Bassey (knee) is out for Friday's game versus the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Branden Carlson
injuries.note: Carlson (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Sacramento.

injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
injuries.note: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.note: Isaac (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.note: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Adou Thiero
injuries.note: Thiero (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries.note: Youngblood (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Kings.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.note: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Tyler Bilodeau
injuries.note: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's game in Cleveland.

injuries.name: Kylan Boswell
injuries.note: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.note: Biberovic (heel) is out for Friday's game against Indiana.

injuries.name: Cameron Carr
injuries.note: Carr (oblique) is out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Otega Oweh
injuries.note: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.note: Sorber (knee) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Denver.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.note: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

injuries.name: Tacko Fall
injuries.note: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.note: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.note: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.note: Bittle (foot) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Bulls.

injuries.name: AJ Dybantsa
injuries.note: Dybantsa (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Raptors, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: LeBron James
injuries.note: James (back) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: De'Aaron Fox
injuries.note: Fox (wrist) participated in Friday's morning shootaround, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.

injuries.name: Cameron Johnson

injuries.name: Brandin Podziemski
injuries.note: Podziemski (back) is probable for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Reed Sheppard
injuries.note: Sheppard (knee) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Spurs.

injuries.name: Cedric Coward
injuries.note: Coward is doubtful for Friday's game against the Warriors due to a left wrist sprain.

injuries.name: Keldon Johnson
injuries.note: Johnson (mouth) participated in shooting drills after Friday's morning shootaround, per Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News.

injuries.name: Steven Adams
injuries.note: Adams (calf) is questionable to play in Friday's game against the Spurs.

injuries.name: Isaiah Stewart
injuries.note: Stewart (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Dean Wade
injuries.note: Wade is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks due to a left ankle sprain.

injuries.name: Spencer Jones
injuries.note: Jones (hamstring) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against Oklahoma City, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.

injuries.name: Luke Kennard

Acquired G Max Strus from Cleveland.
Acquired draft considerations from Cleveland Guardians for G Peyton Watson.

Acquired G Ryan Nembhard from Dallas and G Luguentz Dort from Oklahoma City in a three-team trade that sent F Zaccharie Risacher to Dallas. Dallas received draft consideration from Atlanta, while Oklahoma City received draft considerations from Atlanta and Dallas.
Acquired G Grayson Allen, F Royce O'Neale and draft considerations from Phoenix Suns for F Miles Bridges and draft considerations.
Acquired F Miles Bridges and draft considerations from Charlotte in exchange for G Grayson Allen, F Royce O'Neale and draft considerations.

Acquired F Julius Randle from Minnesota. Waived G Malachi Smith. Signed F Joshua Jefferson to a rookie scale contract.

Acquired F Khris Middleton and draft consideration from Dallas.

Acquired G Caris Levert from Detroit.

Acquired G Jaden Hardy from Washington in exchange for draft considerations.
Acquired draft considerations from Atlanta Hawks for G Aaron Wiggins.
Signed G Anfernee Simons and F Dean Wade to contracts. Acquired G Jaylen Brown from the Boston Celtics. Signed C Ariel Hukporti to a contract.

Re-signed F Andrew Wiggins to a veteran extension. Acquired Fs Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis from the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for Gs Tyler Herro, Jaime Jaquez Jr. and Kasparas Jakucionis, C Kel'el Ware and draft considerations. Signed G Tim Hardaway Jr. to a contract.
